name: Kusarimono
source:
A world where "zombies" and "humans" coexist.
In this world, the protagonist works a strange part-time job in order to save up money, but then one day, he runs into trouble...

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5505]Freem![/url]]
translation:
这是一个“僵尸”与“人类”共存的世界。
在这个世界里，主角为了攒钱而做着一份奇怪的兼职，但有一天，他遇到了麻烦……

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5505]Freem！[/url]]
